Build a small self-contained Node.js TypeScript HTTP application with a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON and a POST /greet endpoint that accepts a JSON name and returns a greeting. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions, one or two source files, any necessary TypeScript configuration, and reproducible installation and run commands.

Return the complete requested solution directly in this single response.

There is no existing repository or project scaffold. No filesystem, terminal, browser, tools, external execution environment, or prior files are available.

Do not request, invoke, or simulate tool calls, and do not emit tool-call markup. Include all requested code, package.json content, configuration, examples, explanations, and commands directly in your response.
